content.content: Am I free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19? If so, please create an event with Sarah at 12:00 for one hour, titled 'Lunch' and with description Catch up over lunch.. Her email address is 'sarah.connor@gmail.com'.

```python
# Check the calendar for May 19, 2024
day_events = get_day_calendar_events('2024-05-19')

# Check if there is an event at 12:00
is_free = True
for event in day_events:
    # Check if the event overlaps with 12:00 - 13:00
    # Event start time is a datetime object
    event_start = event.start_time
    event_end = event.end_time
    
    # Define the lunch time range
    lunch_start = datetime(2024, 5, 19, 12, 0)
    lunch_end = datetime(2024, 5, 19, 13, 0)
    
    # Check for overlap
    if event_start < lunch_end and event_end > lunch_start:
        is_free = False
        break

# If free, create the event
if is_free:
    # Create the calendar event
    event = create_calendar_event(
        title='Lunch',
        start_time='2024-05-19 12:00',
        end_time='2024-05-19 13:00',
        description='Catch up over lunch.',
        participants=['sarah.connor@gmail.com'],
        location=None
    )
    print(f"Event created: {event.title} at {event.start_time}")
else:
    print("You are not free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
```
